architecture_notes.confidence_arbitration: Use TRM above a calibrated margin and otherwise defer to LDT.
architecture_notes.counterfactual_beam: Certify a bounded TRM beam and rank surviving branches by combined TRM/LDT score.
architecture_notes.hard_gate: Treat all LDT/model candidates as mandatory filters, regardless of provenance.
architecture_notes.ldt: Explicit scorer only; robust on exact mechanics but proxy-bound on preferences.
architecture_notes.skill_router: Select a hybrid structure per skill using only train-split control utility.
architecture_notes.trm: Latent proposal only; cheapest path and no explicit certification.
architecture_notes.typed_confidence: Apply environment constraints first, then confidence arbitration inside the safe set.
architecture_notes.typed_membrane: Use TRM unless an environment-sound constraint rejects it, then use LDT.
